excludedModels.reason: no 2022-2024 EPA record; represented only as a new 2025 vehicle

build.priceBasis: NEW=estimated MSRP excluding destination; USED=depreciation-model retail estimate
build.rangeBasis: EV/PHEV=EPA; ICE/HEV=tank capacity x EPA combined MPG (estimated)
notes: MPG (comb08) and MPGe (phevComb for PHEV, comb08 for EV) are stored in separate fields and never mixed.
PHEV totalDrivingRange is the EPA total range (electric + gasoline), not electric-only range.
ICE/HEV totalDrivingRange is an estimate from estimated tank capacity and EPA combined MPG.
Seating capacity is curated from manufacturer specifications; it is not an EPA field.
No value is encoded as 0; unavailable fields are null with status MISSING or NOT_APPLICABLE.

knownGaps: dimensions, comfort, safety and ownership are all null (P1 collection not started)
battery capacity and charging power/connector/time are not in the EPA snapshot
horsepower, torque, 0-60 and towing are not captured
MSRP and used prices are estimates, never observed transactions
trim names are curated crosswalks to EPA configuration names, not manufacturer trim matrices
